title: Mixed Event — Connected Through SEKAI's Cherry Blossoms — Episode7 Connected Feelings

meta.Event Outline: In the Empty SEKAI, Miku's words inspire a discussion among Kanade and the others about having a cherry blossom viewing party. Meanwhile, everyone in the other SEKAI is also planning ways to make the most of the season...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(I knew it...
This is what Kanade showed me that other time...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It doesn't look like a cherry blossom tree... But maybe I should take a look...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(There's something on it.
It's sparkling. What is this...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh?
These sparkly things... Are they...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Minori and the others' feelings?
There's a picture too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But what's with this tree...?
I thought I landed in a big field, but I ended up finding this strange thing. It's like a cherry blossom tree but not...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? This tree...
It has other peoples' feelings on it too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It seems a little different from Minori and the girls' feelings...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, these are definitely Kohane and everyone else's feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. But I'm seeing other peoples' feelings fruiting here as well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (The only possibility I can think of is people from other SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I know that other SEKAI besides ours exist...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But I have a feeling that this isn't any ordinary SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (The feelings of many people all gathered on one tree... I've never seen anything like this before...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (For some reason, it feels like someone's standing right next to me...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(But why is that...?
I don't see anyone else here besides myself.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(But what is this feeling?
It's like I'm not alone here. Am I sensing others standing next to me...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Could it be Miku and the others...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(No, they're not here...
What's going on...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thinking may be a bit futile at this point...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But this tree...
If it's really made out of Tsukasa and everyone else's feelings, I couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It'd be proof that their thoughts and feelings are actually growing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Just seeing this tree makes me feel all warm and fuzzy inside.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It must be because Mafuyu and the others' feelings are shining so brightly...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I want to keep watching over them...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Could it be that she's watching over us...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: My, the others and everyone's feelings...?

They really startled me there...
I wasn't expecting to see all of them here like this.
I take it that their individual desires to help everyone ended up tying them together.
Good luck, everyone. And please keep watching over them...
